page.overview:
Who is Spider?

The mutant only known as Spider is one of the creatures in the Underground City that was created by the . She appears in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus as a co-boss alongside at the end of Chapter 1-1. After the entirety of chapter 1 is completed, all of the underground mutants are restored to their original human forms.

She later appears in the game's Monster Open Tournament mode.

As a mutant, Spider resembles a real spider only vaguely. She has only four long, hairy legs, characteristically similar to a cellar spider. She has two feelers beneath her six green eyes, and a large mouth that is positioned above the eyes.
